artworks.title: Dido
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing near a tree with her right leg crossed in front of the left and her body slightly turned to the right. Her left arm is extended outward while her right arm is bent at the elbow, holding a long nail or spike and a hammer. She has classical facial features and her hair is partially covered with a headscarf. She wears draped, classical-style clothing, and there is a sign with Greek writing at her feet. In the background are trees, rolling hills, a village with buildings, and a castle-like structure. Smoke rises from a fire burning on the ground to her right.

artworks.title: Dance of Cupids
artworks.description: The image shows a group of cherubic figures holding hands in a circle. Each figure has rounded facial features, with chubby cheeks and small noses, and they all have short, curly hair. One figure has small wings on its back. The figures are nude and interacting closely with each other. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Two Fauns Carrying a Child
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two muscular, male figures holding a child in a basket. The drawing depicts two figures standing on either side of the frame. One figure on the left holds a large club over his shoulder and wears a cloth draped around his waist. The man on the right supports a child seated in a basket, with the child reaching towards the left figure. This second man also carries a club over his shoulder and is partially draped with fabric. The scene is backgrounded with tree branches and leaves extending from either side, forming a natural frame. The drawing features intricate cross-hatching and meticulous details suggesting a classical or mythological theme, often associated with ancient tales and legends, and emphasizes the muscular anatomy of the figures.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.description: Printed with black lines and delicate hatching, about twenty mostly nude, muscular people gather or fly across a shaded landscape in this horizontal engraving. The action is mostly focused on a man, Paris, who sits on a cloth-draped rock in front of three women in the left half of the composition. One woman across from and closest to Paris points off to our left as a peacock stands at her feet, its tail fanned open. The second woman and Paris exchange a round object as a nude, pudgy, winged boy pulls at her hip. A winged woman floating overhead is about to crown her with a ring of leaves. The third woman stands with her back to us and holds a piece of drapery up and to our right. A feathered helmet and shield lie at her feet. A dog sits next to Paris, and behind him, a man wearing a winged helmet and carrying a staff with intertwined snakes steps to our right. That man’s back is to us, and he looks over his right shoulder. Three more women to the left gather under a rocky outcropping, where two bulls or cows sit under some trees on the rocky hill in the distance, near the top left corner of the print. Three people recline in the lower right quadrant of the composition. Two of them are bearded, and the male genitals of one is visible. The third is clean-shaven and sits with their back to us while looking over one shoulder. This third person rests one hand on the opening of an urn. One of the bearded men holds a rudder and the other some reeds. In the sky above, a nude man flies a chariot led by four horses through a ring decorated with signs of the zodiac. Two people ride horses in front of him, and to the right, a bearded man, Zeus, holds up a furry-looking object, a lightning bolt. Three women, one with a crescent moon on her head, and an eagle stand or sit around him, and a man supports Zeus on his back. These flying people are surrounded by a bank of white clouds against a shadowy landscape. A river winds into the distance to the right, and the sky is deeply shaded. An inscription at the bottom center reads, “RAPH VRBI INVEN” above the conjoined letters M and A.

artworks.title: Venus Appearing to Aeneas
artworks.description: Two full-body figures are depicted in the image. The person on the left is standing, characterized by long, wavy hair and soft facial features. They are dressed in a flowing garment, holding a spear. The person on the right is seated on a ledge, with short, curly hair, defined facial features, and a muscular torso. This figure wears armor and has their arm resting on a shield placed beside them. The background is filled with detailed trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Orpheus and Eurydice
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in full-body length. On the left is a bearded person standing, playing a stringed instrument resembling a lyre. They have curly hair and are adorned with what appears to be a wreath made of leaves on their head. The person on the right is a woman with wavy hair, styled in a way that a portion is gathered at the back of her head, while a section falls over her shoulder. She is in a contrapposto position, slightly turned towards the left person and looking away. She is partially draped with a cloth around her lower body and across her shoulder. Both figures are barefoot, standing on a natural landscape that consists of grass and small rocks. In the background, there's a textured cliff or rock face on the right, and the top is covered with what seems to be overgrown moss or grass.

artworks.title: The Birth of Venus
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing beside a tree. She appears to be in a slight twist, with her right arm raised to hold a large braid of her long, curly hair. Her facial features are delicate, with a soft expression and long, wavy hair cascading past her shoulders. The woman is not wearing any clothing. Around her is a textured ground with patches of grass and a rocky surface, and a small body of water or shoreline visible behind her. In the background are a few distant boats on the water and a range of mountains on the horizon. To the left of the woman is a hanging spherical object attached to the tree with a string and some twisted elements.

artworks.title: Vulcan, Venus, and Eros
artworks.description: The image shows a blacksmith scene in a rural landscape. A muscular figure is working with a hammer and anvil, accompanied by a winged child and another seated figure. The setting includes lush trees on the left and a distant town or village in the background. The figures are intricately detailed with a focus on anatomical structure and drapery. The shading and line work convey depth and texture throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Mars, Venus, and Eros
artworks.artist: Marcantonio Raimondi possibly after Andrea Mantegna
artworks.description: The image displays three figures: a man, a woman, and a child. The man is seated on the ground next to a tree, with his right arm raised and resting on the tree trunk. The woman is standing beside the man, holding a torch above her head. A small winged child reaches up to touch the woman's waist. The man's side features a shield with a face and pieces of armor. In the background, there are dense trees, a castle with spires, and a countryside. The artwork is detailed with fine lines.

artworks.title: Hercules and Antaeus
artworks.description: There are two nude male figures in the image. One man is being lifted or held aloft by the other, with only his toes on the ground. The man being lifted has curly hair and his head tilted back, eyes half-closed, and an open mouth. The other man has a muscular build, a bearded face, and intense, focused eyes. The background depicts a mix of natural and architectural elements, including a tree trunk, foliage, ancient ruins, columns, stone structures, trees, and hills.

artworks.title: The Man with Two Trumpets
artworks.description: This is a print showing several people engaged in various activities in a setting with tall trees and columns. In the center, a nude man stands, holding two long trumpets up to his mouth, extending out to the left and right. In front of him, a person with their back to us is bent over under a large stone-like block that they carry on their back. On the left, a man and woman are both holding up a large sphere with a stick extending from it that the woman holds. They are both nude, although the woman has a thin piece of fabric draped around her shoulders and arms. To the right, an old man with a long beard is dressed in a draping robe and stands next to another nude man who holds a thin staff. Columns and archways with a statue above them are visible in the background on the right, while the left shows a hilly landscape under a clear sky.

artworks.title: Raphael's Dream
artworks.description: Printed with black lines against oatmeal-white paper, two nude women lie near four imaginary, nightmarish creatures on a rocky riverbank in this horizontal engraving. Stone buildings of the town across the water beyond them are on fire, and the sky is filled with dark clouds. Closest to us, in the lower left corner of the composition, the two pale women lie, one in front of the other, nearly parallel to the bottom edge of the paper. Their heads are near the left edge and their feet reach halfway across the composition. The woman closer to us has her back to us, and her head is tipped back so we see her profile. The other woman’s body faces us. They both have long curly hair, and their eyes are closed. Their arms rest down the length of their bodies. Cloth is draped under their bodies and around the lower legs of the woman whose body faces us. Their torsos are propped up on rocky outcroppings, which rise behind the pair and echo the curving form of their bodies. The four fantasy creatures cluster on a flat area near the water, in the lower right corner. Each is made up of body parts from different animals. One to our left in that group has a sheep’s face, a body shaped like a caterpillar, seven insect-like legs, rounded fins or wings, and a cluster of stingers at the tail. Drool or something else drips from its mouth. At first glance, a creature on the lower right resembles a conch shell, but the opening is like bat’s head with oversized ears, and a protruding lower lip to make the shell’s opening. It rests on clawed feet. Closest to the water, a critter has a lizard’s head, which is folded back with gaping mouth open, over a slug-like body, and two paws with long claws. The final creature is hard to make sense of. It has a long neck, like a reading lamp, ending in a bird-like head. Its body looks like a second goat-like face, and the almond-shaped tail seems to come from the goat’s mouth. It stands on two clawed feet. A stone building rises up the left edge of the composition, behind the women. A band of water separates this bank from the town beyond, the buildings of which come to the water’s edge. To our right, rectangular and arched doorways and windows are backlit by flames, and smoke pours out of the upper stories. People shown as dark or light silhouettes clamber up stairs and carry others. In a nearby boat on the water, a person uses a pole to propel the vessel and the five smaller people, probably children, it holds. More people are in a longer boat farther back from us, in front of a complex of buildings with shallow rooflines or crenellations. A three-rayed flash emanates from a rocky hill between this complex and the burning building to our right.

artworks.title: Poetry
artworks.description: The image depicts a central figure surrounded by clouds, flanked by two smaller winged figures. The central figure is seated with her right arm resting on a book and her left arm holding a curved object. She has a serene expression with downcast eyes, and her hair is styled simply with a laurel wreath. She wears a flowing dress and has large wings. The cherub on her left holds a scroll, while the other cherub on her right grasps an object resembling a ribbon. The background is filled with clouds.

artworks.title: Serpent Speaking to a Young Man
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene involving three figures and a serpent. Three figures are depicted in classical Greek or Roman attire, with one standing on the left, one in the center holding a staff, and one sitting on the right. A serpent, appearing to have a human head, coils on the ground between the figures. The background shows a landscape with trees and distant structures. The drawing is detailed, showcasing natural elements like foliage and the poses of the figures, typical of engravings. The drawing has a narrative quality, possibly depicting a mythological or symbolic theme.

artworks.title: Two Women with the Zodiac
artworks.description: The image shows two full-bodied figures. The person on the left is positioned with one knee bent on a rectangular block, leaning forward while holding an object resembling a book or tablet. This person has wavy hair styled back. They are wearing a draped garment reminiscent of classical attire, and there is a tree in the background to their left. The person on the right stands with one foot in front of the other while looking back over their shoulder. Their hair cascades loosely in waves, and they are clothed in flowing garments similar to the other figure. This person holds an object that could be a tablet or plank. The background includes a tree and shrubbery. Above and to the right, there are symbolic elements, including a scorpion and scales set in what appears to be a sky or celestial scene. A rectangular empty frame lies between the figures.

artworks.title: The Three Doctors
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.3 x 10.1 cm (2 7/8 x 4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts three people sitting on the ground outdoors. Individual on the left is cross-legged with prominent facial features, wearing a hat and robe. The middle person is sitting with one leg extended and another bent, looking at the viewer. The person on the right is gesturing, wearing a robe and hat. In the background, there is a building with a slanted roof and trees on either side. The illustration is detailed with lines and shading.

artworks.title: Il Morbetto (The Plague)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.5 x 25.2 cm (7 11/16 x 9 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: Printed with black lines and hatching, a shadowy structure to the left is separated from an open space leading back to another building by a herm, which has a human head atop a squared column, in this horizontal engraving. In the structure to the left, a cleanshaven young man holds a burning torch up to look at three dead sheep lying in a heap on the ground. A fourth sheep nibbles at the earth beside the man, and a cow lies at the edge of the torchlight to the left. A half flight of stairs leads up to a second level, where a man lies on his side on a bed. Two women with their heads covered attend to him on the far side of the bed. Light pours in through an arched window over the head of the bed, and text, also appearing to stream in, reads, “EF FIGIES SACRAE DIVOMP HRI.” On the right half of the composition, two men hunch over a dead woman while a baby pulls on her breast. One man reaches out and touches the baby’s face with one hand while touching his own with the other. An older woman behind the trio to the right holds up one hand, palm facing out, to hide her face, and a young person looks on next to her. A bearded man turns away on the other side of the scene. A broken column with fluted sides lies just beyond this group. An animal, perhaps a horse or donkey, lies next to the path in the near distance. One person stands and three people sit near or on two boxes farther back, right in front of the building that encloses most of the space on the right half of the composition. More towers, rooftops, and buildings fill in the gap between the main structure and the right edge of the composition. The herm separating the two scenes has a square base, tall, rectangular pedestal, and an angular, triangular section beneath the man’s head, which has eyes closed. Text on the bottommost base reads, “LINQVEBANT DVLCES ANIMAS, AVT AEGRA TRAHEBANT CORP.”

artworks.title: The Vision of Saint Helena
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a bench or ledge, leaning against one arm with their hand on their forehead. The person is in profile with eyes closed and wearing a cap or headscarf. They are dressed in a loose gown, and in the background, there is a framed picture or window showing an angel flying over a cityscape while holding a cross.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a seated figure in an interior setting. The composition features detailed clothing, armor, expressions, and weapons like spears and a spiked mace. The seated figure appears to be in a position of authority, with a lion and a fantastical creature beneath the throne. A decorative curtain drapes the top right corner, adding to the interior's ornate setting. Strong lines and detailed shading provide depth and texture to the drawing.

artworks.title: Christ and the Woman of Samaria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene at a well. The image depicts two figures standing by a well, one on each side. The well has detailed stonework patterns on its surface, a large covered roof, and a pulley mechanism with a bucket being held by one of the figures. The environment around the well shows trees and foliage. In the background, there is a distant landscape with a silhouetted castle or tower. The detailed linework and shading bring texture to the scene, emphasizing the features of the clothing worn by the figures and the materials of the well.

artworks.title: Saint Andrew
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures surrounding a tall standing individual. The scene includes detailed figures, with the central character on the left holding a staff or spear. The background includes a rocky outcrop and trees, giving context to the scene. The style is reminiscent of the works from the Northern Renaissance, suggesting an artist who favored intricate woodcut designs.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical religious scene with figures engaged in a ritual. The illustration depicts a detailed gathering of individuals in a religious setting. A central figure is kneeling on the steps in front of an ornately decorated altar. The scene includes onlookers to the left, dressed in period-appropriate clothing. The woodcut style features detailed shading and line work, emphasizing expressions and postures. The altar is adorned with intricate carvings and possibly shields or heraldic symbols, with an extended candlestick on the left.

artworks.title: Saint Philip
artworks.description: This is a drawing illustrating an execution scene. It depicts a man chained to a large wooden structure surrounded by a group of people. In the foreground, several figures are on horseback, wearing armor and clothing. The man in the center is elevated above the group holding a large cross or pole. Surrounding the group are spears and flags, with a hilly landscape, trees, and a building in the background. The style is reminiscent of a woodcut engraving, showcasing detailed craftsmanship and attention to linear detail.

artworks.title: Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of knights and onlookers. The scene depicts various figures engaged in or observing an act involving a person tied to a long board or table. The composition features knights in ornate armor holding spears and a setting that suggests a historical event. The drawing is detailed with intricate line work, depicting armor, textiles, and architectural elements like arches and buildings. There is attention to facial expressions and postures, indicating a narrative or significant event. The style is reminiscent of German woodcuts, possibly from the Northern Renaissance period.
